name: site/breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
summary: The breadcrumb trail of a marketing page: a labelled <nav> with an ordered list of links, and the matching schema.org BreadcrumbList JSON-LD, both from one `items` array. Fewer than two items render nothing.

props.name: items
props.description: The trail, root first: `{ name: string; url?: string }` (site-breadcrumbs.ts, which also derives it from a pathname). The last item is the current page.

props.name: origin
props.description: The absolute origin that expands site-relative urls in the JSON-LD (Google requires absolute). Falls back to the site's configured URL, then the request's origin.

behaviour: With fewer than two items it renders nothing at all: no nav, no JSON-LD.
Otherwise it renders <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb"> holding an <ol>; each item is an <li>, with an aria-hidden "/" <li> between items.
The last item is plain text in a <span aria-current="page">, whatever its url. An earlier item with a url is a link; one without a url is plain text with no aria-current.

After the nav it emits a <script type="application/ld+json"> BreadcrumbList: one ListItem per item, position from 1, `item` an absolute URL. A relative url is joined to `origin` (else the site URL, else the request origin); an item without a url uses the current request's pathname.

default.description: Three crumbs, with an explicit origin.

request-origin.description: No origin: the JSON-LD uses the request's origin; a middle crumb without a url is plain text; an absolute url is kept.

keyboard: Tab moves through the crumb links; the current page is not a link.
focus: Links rely on the browser's default focus outline.
aria: The "/" separators are aria-hidden list items.

theming.brandOverlay: Nothing: the trail is muted text and the current page foreground.

noJs.without: Everything: the only <script> is JSON-LD data, never executed.

responsive: The list wraps (flex-wrap) on a narrow screen; the current page truncates rather than overflow.
contract:
contract
  slot is "breadcrumb"
  label is "Breadcrumb"
  class is "text-body-sm text-muted-foreground"
  when request-origin class is "text-body-sm text-muted-foreground mb-6"
  when default shows a "Education"
  when default shows span "K12 Digital Campus"
  when request-origin shows span "Blog"
end

checks.say: One list item per crumb, plus a separator between each.
The separators are hidden from assistive technology.
Earlier crumbs with a url are links.
The current page in the default trail.
The last crumb is never a link, even with a url.
A middle crumb without a url is plain text, not current.
JSON-LD urls are absolute, on the given origin.
A crumb without a url is the current request path.
Without an origin, relative urls use the request origin.

gaps: Crumb links are inline text with no minimum target height (WCAG 2.5.8 relies on the inline-text exception) and no explicit `--ring` focus style.
A middle crumb without a url still gets a JSON-LD `item` of the current page's URL, which misstates that crumb's location.
The fallback to `Astro.site` / the request origin is Astro-specific; the React build takes the request URL as `requestUrl`.
